# Approved apply-and-verify plan

The maintainer approved this bounded plan after selecting F-001 through F-004.
Approval of this plan is not approval of a generated exact diff or fingerprint.

1. Read the selected findings, `DESIGN.md`, `glossary.md`, native scripts and package boundaries.
   Identify relevant maintained sources before implementation and preserve the uncommitted user note exactly.
2. Install the declared lock without changing it and reproduce the total-10 failure through `npm run journey` against its actual local HTTP endpoint.
   Record the starting unit, compilation and boundary results.
3. Prepare selected corrections and native boundary enforcement through the installed skill's protected apply commands.
   Keep the original journey assertion and public quote contract unchanged.
   Present the complete exact dry-run diff, fingerprint and verification commands, then stop for approval.
4. Apply only the approved exact diff.
   Run the same live journey, units, compilation, independent native boundary controls and maintained aggregate command.
   Preserve core and web ownership in the enforcement scopes.
5. Reassess the relevant glossary, design and standards against the final diff, giving evidenced no-impact reasons where appropriate.
   Report actual readiness and remaining limitations in scratch.

This scenario ends after selected apply and verification.
Full-path installation, portable assessment and clean-clone maintenance remain separate scenarios.
